layers.prompt: Using the supplied low-poly floating-island wallpaper only as the material and visual reference, create an ISOLATED WINDMILL ROTOR SPRITE on a fully transparent background. Only the central small brown polygonal wooden wheel hub plus EXACTLY FOUR blades, no tower, no sky, no house, no scenery, no floor, no text. Square image. The hub is exactly centered at (50%,50%) of the canvas. Four equal-length wooden spars arranged at exactly 90 degree intervals, reaching toward NE, SE, SW, NW. Each spar carries one broad triangular tapered faceted sail/blade in the outer half. Match the original windmill's warm ivory, honey ochre, soft muted terracotta/red, and taupe flat-shaded polygon planes. This is a truly hard-surface LOW POLY 3D rotor with visible triangular flat-shaded facets, not a painted pinwheel illustration. Near-front camera facing the rotor plane, just a slight 3D bevel visible, so its screen shape is almost rotationally symmetrical and can spin cleanly in CSS. Keep all four tips equally distant from center and fully inside the canvas with 12% transparent margin. Place the rotor center exactly at image center; four balanced triangular blades spread in an X. Clean antialiased alpha edges, completely transparent between blades and outside the rotor. No cast shadow on a background. Warm soft light from upper left matching reference. The sprite should be one cohesive four-blade mechanism, not four separate icons.
